text:
ashley_ng: FYI we have an in-person pairing loop scheduled for Zara Patel next Tue 13:00-16:00 PT. She requested a Mac loaner (M1) with Docker and Python 3.10, plus a quiet room with directional microphone because she uses a personal FM assistive listening device. Can we confirm availability?

kevin_m: Hiring manager  here  the loop is pairing-heavy (2x pairing sessions) + brief brown-bag. Quiet room + mic is a must. Also Zara asked if she can present a 10-min portfolio segment during the wrap.

jordan_s: I can reserve Focus Room C (floor 2) and add the hybrid link. Need to know if the Mac should have Rosetta + Homebrew installed.

it_ops: We have two MacBooks (M1) in loaner pool. I can image one with Homebrew, Python 3.10, Docker Desktop (with experimental support). Note: Docker on M1 uses qemu; please confirm whether native arm image is needed or we should preload amd64 images via buildx. Also we can attach a Scarlett directional mic and an FM receiver adapter.

ashley_ng: Please preload an arm64 test image `company/pairing-eval:arm64-v1` (1.1GB). Zara noted she can't use any unapproved persistent cloud sync on the laptop; please disable iCloud and remove auto-updates.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Zara Patel  travel: Dublin, prefers EUR reimbursement. Visa: not required. Email: z.patel@example.ie. Requested a private phone interview prior to travel; recruiter scheduled at 09:00 local.

kevin_m: Also confirm meal: Zara is pescatarian and low-histamine. Single sealed lunch, no shellfish. If possible include labeled snack bars (gluten-free).

jordan_s: Locking Focus Room C 12:30-16:30 for setup/teardown. Zoom link: https://zoom.company.com/j/333333333. I'll ask front desk to print a visitor badge and note "Quiet room - assistive device".

it_ops: Imaging in progress. Need candidate's SSH public key if they want test artifacts persisted, otherwise we'll provide a local temp account. Also confirm whether internet access should be restricted; default is outbound allowed.

ashley_ng: Restrict internet to allow only internal mirrors + local registry for the eval. Candidate asked for no external uploads. I'll obtain SSH key if they want it.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Calendar invite created and sent to z.patel@example.ie, Kevin, Jordan, Ashley. Invite ID: 1876543210-zrpa.

kevin_m: Can we add a short agenda to the invite? Also include directions for nearest tram stop and how to request 2hr validated street parking.

jordan_s: Agenda snippet:
```
12:30  setup + mic check
13:00  Intro / Hiring mgr (Kevin)
13:20  Pairing session A (45m)
14:10  Short break + buffer
14:25  Pairing session B (45m)
15:15  Portfolio + wrap (10m)
15:30  Recruiter + next steps
```

it_ops: Adding note: bring candidate's charger (USB-C) and we will provide a USB-C power brick. Mic will be sanitized and FM receiver battery checked.

ashley_ng: I'll add transit + parking validation (code TR-22, 2 hours) and the request to disable iCloud in the invite. Also sending Zara a laptop security waiver form to sign before arrival.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Zara confirmed she will sign the waiver and prefers EUR reimbursement. End of thread.
